bools.name: dezT43ConBonusStopsAfter9

bools.name: dezWizTenthLevelSpellsCount

bools.name: dezWizIntroPhysicallyWeak
bools.comment: the wizard framing: physically weak, but the right combination of protective magical items makes them all but invulnerable except to high-level warriors and other high-level wizards (printed p. 156).

bools.name: dezSageOneCategoryAlchemyOrChemistry
bools.comment: the sage constraint: one of the two categories must be Alchemy or Chemistry, reflecting the knowledge of magical potions and scroll inks (printed pp. 157-158).

bools.name: dezSageOtherCategoryPlayerOrDm
bools.comment: the sage second category: the player can choose it or the DM can assign one (printed pp. 157-158).

bools.name: dezSageDifficultAnswersOtherRoutes
bools.comment: the sage fallback: a difficult question can always be answered by consulting another character, undertaking an adventure, or lengthy and expensive research (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizFocusIntWisDex
bools.comment: the mental focus targets: a temporary bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom or Dexterity (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizFocusOneBoostAtATime
bools.comment: the mental focus limit: only one ability score improvement can operate at any given time (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizFocusConcentrationRoundOnlyAction
bools.comment: the mental focus round: no other actions while concentrating one round (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizFocusBoostEndsAtWill

bools.name: dezWizFocusNoEffectIfEqualOrHigher

bools.name: dezWizFocusSubabilitiesRaisedEqual

bools.name: dezWizFocusBonusesImmediate
bools.comment: the mental focus timing: bonuses apply immediately on success and are lost immediately when the boost ends (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizSigItemLikeWarriorSkill
bools.comment: the wizard signature item: except as noted, operates exactly like the warrior skill of the same name (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezWizSigItemOnePerType
bools.comment: the wizard signature item limit: as many items as the wizard pays for, but no more than one of any type of item (printed p. 158).

bools.name: dezSculptRequiresFocusItem
bools.comment: the sculpting preparation: the wizard must prepare an item to focus and reshape the spell energy - a small object such as a jewel, wand or amulet (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptFocusNotConsumed
bools.comment: the sculpting component: the focus item is an additional material component, normally not consumed (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptFailCastsNormally
bools.comment: the sculpting failure: a failed skill roll casts the spell normally (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptOnceOnly
bools.comment: the sculpting limit: it is not possible to sculpt a spell more than once (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptNoTouchOrZeroRange
bools.comment: the sculpting range exclusion: a spell with a range of touch or 0 cannot be extended (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptNoInstantaneousDuration
bools.comment: the sculpting duration exclusion: spells with instantaneous durations cannot be extended (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptLocalMultiplierFirst
bools.comment: the sculpting order: if local conditions lengthen the casting time, apply the multiplier first, then cut the result in half (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptNoDicelessDamage
bools.comment: the sculpting damage exclusion: spells that do not use dice rolls to determine damage cannot be sculpted for damage (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptIndividualDiceNotIncreased
bools.comment: the sculpting missile rule: spells with individual damage dice such as magic missile are not increased individually - the extra dice can join one missile or split across two (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptMetamagicAllowedIfNoDuplication
bools.comment: the sculpting metamagic combo: a metamagic spell can apply to a sculpted spell provided the effects do not duplicate (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptFullCostPerSpell
bools.comment: the sculpting cost: learning to sculpt more than one spell requires the full skill cost for each spell (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculptImprovementAllSpells
bools.comment: the sculpting improvement: a base-score increase applies to all spells the wizard knows how to sculpt (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezSculstRequirementsStillMet
bools.comment: the sculpting cast: the wizard must meet all the usual requirements to cast the spell (printed pp. 158-159).

bools.name: dezAllPriestsCastTrueDweomers
bools.comment: the priest dweomer rule: all priests, even druids, cast true dweomers at 20th level - a new approach to magic very high-level druids can understand and use (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdMightBeCalled8th
bools.comment: the priest dweomer naming: for a priest a true dweomer might be called an 8th-level spell, but it functions just like a wizard true dweomer (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdUsesDivinePower
bools.comment: the priest dweomer source: unlike wizards, priests use divine power to create their true dweomers (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdMustPromoteDeityInterests
bools.comment: the priest dweomer constraint: any true dweomer a priest casts must promote the deity interests in some way (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdRequiresGoodStanding
bools.comment: the priest dweomer standing: the priest must be in good standing with the deity, having observed the requirements of both the alignment and the ethos (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdSpherePortfolioLikelyGranted
bools.comment: the priest dweomer judgment: a true dweomer impacting the deity sphere of control or portfolio is likely to be granted unless it runs contrary to that power wishes (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestTdCheckSpheresWhenInDoubt
bools.comment: the priest dweomer check: when in doubt, check the spheres of normal spells the priest can cast - effects found in those spells are probably acceptable (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezPriestsFormidableInCombat
bools.comment: the priest framing: priests combine spellcasting abilities with combat power, formidable with magical armor and weapons, but their primary strength comes from spells (printed pp. 159-160).

bools.name: dezT45ConBonusStopsAfter9
bools.comment: the Table 45 footnote: bonus hit points from high Constitution scores are not added after 9th level (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezQuestSpellNoSacrifice
bools.comment: the quest spell rule: a priest with access to true dweomers receives a quest spell without sacrificing any spellcasting ability (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezQuestSpellOtherRequirementsNormal
bools.comment: the quest spell catch: all other requirements for receiving a quest spell must be met normally, per the Tome of Magic (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezTurningRepeatWhileSuccessful
bools.comment: the improved turning rule: the priest may continue to turn undead so long as prior attempts against the same group were successful (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezTurningStopsAfterFail
bools.comment: the improved turning stop: once an attempt fails the priest cannot continue (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezTurningMixedGroupUselessOnUnaffected
bools.comment: the improved turning mixed groups: further attempts to turn the unaffected creatures of a mixed group are useless (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezTurningWeakerContinueIfSucceed
bools.comment: the improved turning weaker creatures: weaker creatures continue to be affected as long as attempts against them succeed (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezWulfLichUnaffected
bools.comment: the Wulf lich outcome: the roll of 7 is insufficient to turn the lich, and it stays unaffected on later rounds (printed p. 160).

bools.name: dezSpellSelectMinorOrLevelEitherWay
bools.comment: the spell selection form: either minor access to a previously inaccessible sphere or access to another level in an existing minor sphere (printed pp. 160-161).

bools.name: dezSpellSelectDmOrPlayerChooses
bools.comment: the spell selection chooser: the DM can make the selection or let the player choose (printed pp. 160-161).

bools.name: dezArmySingleTask
bools.comment: the holy army task: called up to accomplish a single task through force of arms - destroying a castle, temple or town, rescuing a captive, recovering a stolen item, bringing a fugitive to justice, deposing a ruler (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyTaskWithinAlignment
bools.comment: the holy army constraint: the task cannot violate the principles of the priest alignment or ethos (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyOneAtATime
bools.comment: the holy army limit: cannot summon one while another is in the field (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyOncePerYear
bools.comment: the holy army frequency: no more than one each year (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyOfficersHavePriests
bools.comment: the holy army clergy: each commander and assistant is accompanied by a priest or cleric of similar level (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyOpenWorshipRequired
bools.comment: the holy army summoning place: somewhere people worship the character deity openly (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyGatherDoubledIfUncommon
bools.comment: the holy army slow gather: if worshippers are not common in the area the gathering time is doubled (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmySmallerAllowed
bools.comment: the holy army option: the priest can summon a smaller army (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyPayOrCharismaCheck
bools.comment: the holy army extension route: pay the troops well or make a successful Charisma/Leadership check (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyGoalWithinReach
bools.comment: the holy army condition: the army goal must be within easy reach (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezArmyDisbandIndependenceRisk
bools.comment: the holy army disband: troops may remain together as an independent force - best seen home to keep radical elements from taking control (printed pp. 161-162).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusWisStrCha
bools.comment: the divine strength targets: a temporary bonus to Wisdom, Strength or Charisma (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusNoBonusSpells
bools.comment: the divine strength casting note: the priest gains no bonus spells from this skill (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusWis19Immunity
bools.comment: the divine strength Wisdom note: a Wisdom score of 19 or higher grants immunity to certain spells per the Player Handbook Table 5 (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusOneBoostAtATime
bools.comment: the divine strength limit: only one ability score improvement can operate at any given time (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusConcentrationRoundOnlyAction
bools.comment: the divine strength round: no other actions while concentrating (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusBoostEndsAtWill
bools.comment: the divine strength control: the priest can end the boost and restore the other scores at any time (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusNoEffectIfHigher
bools.comment: the divine strength ceiling: no effect if the ability score is already higher than the table value - the priest wording, printed verbatim (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezPriestFocusSubabilitiesRaisedEqual
bools.comment: the divine strength subabilities: under the optional rule both subabilities of the boosted score rise to the same value (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceFullRoundSpeech
bools.comment: the divine voice form: the priest must speak loudly and clearly for a full round, the check made at the end of the round (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoicePenetratesSilence
bools.comment: the divine voice silence rule: the voice penetrates silence spells (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceAntimagicShields
bools.comment: the divine voice shielding: antimagic shells, prismatic spheres, cubes of force and 10th-level ward spells shield their occupants (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceMagicalDeafnessBlocks
bools.comment: the divine voice hearing: creatures magically deafened cannot hear it (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceSaveVsSpellOthers
bools.comment: the divine voice save: creatures with 5 or more Hit Dice or levels can save vs. spell to avoid the effect (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceHearingOnlyRequired
bools.comment: the divine voice understanding: creatures do not have to understand the words, merely hear them (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceUndeadAndCharmImmuneUnaffected
bools.comment: the divine voice immunities: undead and creatures normally immune to charm spells, such as golems, are not affected (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceWis19Immune
bools.comment: the divine voice willpower gate: creatures with Wisdom/Willpower scores of 19 or more are not affected (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceJeeringBreaks
bools.comment: the divine voice break: excessive jeering can break the effects, per the enthrall spell description (printed p. 161).

bools.name: dezVoiceOneMassSuggestionPerUse
bools.comment: the divine voice limit: only one mass suggestion per use of the skill (printed p. 161).

bools.comment: the divine voice suggestion save: no saving throw against the mass suggestion if completed before the enthrall effect ends (printed p. 161).

bools.comment: the divine voice spread: the mass suggestion affects every creature currently enthralled regardless of the priest level (printed p. 161).

bools.comment: the divine voice gate: ineffective if the eminence score is zero or less (printed p. 161).

bools.comment: the divine will scope: effective against any effect that makes the priest act according to another creature will - all forms of charm, geas, quest, fear, beguiling, command (printed p. 162).

bools.name: dezWillEjectsMagicJarPsyche
bools.comment: the divine will magic jar: the invading psyche is ejected (printed p. 162).

bools.name: dezWillIneffectiveAtZero
bools.comment: the divine will gate: ineffective when the eminence score is zero or less (printed p. 162).

bools.name: dezDeceiveSeesFalsehoods
bools.comment: the detect deception effect: a successful roll uncovers any falsehood encountered, false images from illusions or false statements from creatures (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveAutoSpokenFalsehoods
bools.comment: the detect deception speech: while in effect the priest detects all forms of spoken falsehoods automatically for the duration (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.comment: the detect deception nuance: unlike a detect lie spell the priest knows when a creature is deliberately evading the truth (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.comment: the detect deception limit: the skill does not tell the priest what the truth is, only that a lie or evasion was heard (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveMagicSpeechUnheard
bools.comment: the detect deception magic speech: if magic allows falsehoods to be spoken the priest cannot hear the protected creature speak, revealing the falsehood indirectly (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveImmediateSaveVsIllusion
bools.comment: the detect deception visions: an immediate saving throw vs. spell to see through any false vision or visual distortion from a spell, item or creature (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveDmSecretRoll
bools.comment: the detect deception roll: the DM should make the vision save secretly (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.comment: the detect deception exclusion: illusion spells that create no image, such as invisibility, are not affected (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveDefeatsDisplacementBlending
bools.comment: the detect deception items: defeats cloaks of displacement, robes of blending and similar items (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveNotVsPhysicalChanges
bools.comment: the detect deception shape limit: no power against effects that disguise through physical changes, such as polymorph self or shape change (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezDeceiveIneffectiveAtZero
bools.comment: the detect deception gate: ineffective when the base eminence score is zero or less (printed pp. 162-163).

bools.name: dezEminenceAuraUndetectable
bools.comment: the eminence aura: undetectable except by a true seeing spell (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceHaloByAlignment
bools.comment: the eminence halo: true seeing reveals a bright silver, inky black or pearl gray halo depending on the priest alignment (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceFearAtWill
bools.comment: the eminence trigger: if the priest wills it the fear takes hold (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceSaveForStronger
bools.comment: the eminence save: more powerful creatures get a saving throw vs. spell to negate the fear (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceWorksVsFearImmune
bools.comment: the eminence reach: works against all types of creatures, even those normally immune to fear attacks such as undead (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceCloakOrRemoveFearBreaks
bools.comment: the eminence negations: a cloak of bravery or remove fear spell breaks the effect (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceSkillBreaks
bools.comment: the eminence counters: a successful use of the warrior skill bravery or the priest skill divine will breaks the effect (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceOnceResistedImmuneRestOfDay
bools.comment: the eminence resistance: once a creature has resisted the fear it is not subject to fear effects from the same priest for the rest of the day (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceOpposingPriestShields
bools.comment: the eminence opposition: creatures within 30 feet of an opposing priest using eminence are not subject to the fear if the second priest level is equal or higher (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceIneffectiveAtZero
bools.comment: the eminence gate: ineffective when the base eminence score is zero or less (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminencePrereqFiveSkills
bools.comment: the eminence prerequisite list, printed verbatim: a prerequisite for the divine strength, divine voice, divine will, detect deception and invincibility skills - noting the printed tension: the Table 40 roster and the divine will detail read Priest 10+ without eminence (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceDrainsBySkill
bools.comment: the eminence drain rule: each use of the five dependent skills reduces the base eminence score by two for either one day or one week, depending on the skill used (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezEminenceZeroBlocksAll
bools.comment: the eminence lockout: once the base score falls to zero the priest cannot use eminence or any of the other skills (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezSmiteConnectedButUsableAtZero
bools.comment: the eminence smite link: the smite skill is connected to the eminence score but can be used, at some risk, when eminence is zero or less (printed p. 163).

bools.name: dezInvLikeWarriorHardiness
bools.comment: the invincibility kinship: very similar to the warrior skill hardiness (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvSaveFirst
bools.comment: the invincibility save order: if the effect allows a saving throw the priest rolls the save before checking the skill (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvNoSimpleOrContinuingDamage

bools.name: dezInvNoCharmsEntangleImprison

bools.name: dezInvCureWithinDelayNoHarm

bools.name: dezInvShorterDurationNoEffect

bools.name: dezInvShockFailFullForce
bools.comment: the invincibility failure: a failed system shock means the full force of the effect - possible to rest for months and wake only to die (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvMultipleEffectsSequential

bools.name: dezInvUnconsciousRecoversInstantly

bools.name: dezInvHeroicRoundsEqualDelay

bools.name: dezInvHeroicDeathAtDelayEnd
bools.comment: the heroic effort price: reduced to -20 or less the character dies once the delay expires (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvRaiseDuringDelaySaves
bools.comment: the heroic rescue: a raise dead or resurrection cast during the delay prevents death (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvRegenNoShock
bools.comment: the invincibility regeneration: a character returned to life through regeneration need not make a system shock roll (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvAmuletNoShock
bools.comment: the invincibility amulet: an amulet of life protection works like regeneration with no system shock roll (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvIneffectiveAtZero
bools.comment: the invincibility gate: ineffective when the base eminence score is zero or less (printed pp. 163-165).

bools.name: dezInvDrainRestOfDay

bools.name: dezLoanTransfersVitality

bools.name: dezLoanUnwillingNeedsAttackRoll

bools.name: dezLoanLostLikeDamage

bools.name: dezLoanUselessAtZero

bools.name: dezSmiteConeAnyDirection

bools.name: dezSmiteOnlyEnemiesHarmed

bools.name: dezSmiteAweDefault

bools.name: dezSmiteAweDepiction
bools.comment: the smite awe image: a two-dimensional depiction of the deity or its symbol appears before the priest (printed pp. 165-166).

bools.name: dezSmiteAweDistractionBreaks

bools.name: dezSmiteBlindUntilHealed
bools.comment: the smite blind duration: until a heal or cure blindness or deafness spell (printed pp. 165-166).

bools.name: dezSmiteDeafUntilHealed

bools.comment: the smite immobilize kill: striking the crystalline body with any hard object forces a save as rock crystal vs. crushing blow, only ring, cloak and armor bonuses count, failure is death (printed pp. 165-166).

bools.name: dezSmitePlagueDebilitating

bools.name: dezSmitePlagueNotContagiousOrFatal
bools.comment: the smite plague limits: neither contagious nor fatal (printed pp. 165-166).

bools.comment: the smite plague grant: when the targets are offensive but pose no danger to the deity interests (printed pp. 165-166).

bools.name: dezSmiteSlowWhenNoImmediateThreat

bools.name: dezTalFailWastesSpell

bools.name: dezTalComponentsRequired
bools.comment: the talisman casting: all material components on hand and all usual casting requirements met (printed pp. 166-167).

bools.name: dezTalCastingEffectsOnFail
bools.comment: the talisman price: casting effects such as unnatural aging hit the priest even if the spell was not placed (printed pp. 166-167).

bools.comment: the talisman capacity: the total levels stored cannot exceed the priest level (printed pp. 166-167).

audit_comment: DMO Chapter 7 round three of five (printed pp. 156-167): the Table 43 wizard advancement grid (375K XP steps, the proficiency columns, the 10+N d4 hit points), the Table 44 wizard spell progression with its true dweomer column, the sage ability thresholds and its 1d3+1-weeks research example, the wizard skills - mental focus with the 18-to-22 boost ladder, the six signature item categories, spell sculpting with its fireball/burning hands/magic missile worked examples and the shared 1st-to-7th cap chain; the priest true dweomer doctrine, the Table 45 advancement grid (cleric and druid XP ladders, the 9+N d8 hit points), the priest spell progression grid (body caption Table 47, contents Table 46), the quest spell, improved turning with the Wulf example, spell selection at 21/25/27, the holy army with its halving officer chain; and the nine priest skills - divine strength (18-to-22 ladder), divine voice (180 feet, rock and lead penetration, the enthrall and mass suggestion rules), divine will, detect deception (the one-to-five turn duration ladder), eminence (the 30-foot fear, the +4 reaction bonus, the five-skill prerequisite list with its printed divine will tension), invincibility (the 5/10/15-round delay ladder, the 96-percent system shock example, the nine-week vampire-and-lich sum), loan (the 1d8+2 to 4d6+8 grid), smite (the 30-to-110-foot cone ladder, all nine deific effects, the Marissa example) and the spell talisman (the Wulf storage example).
